text: Linear - Composio Toolkit | Composio All Toolkits Linear LINEAR Latest version 20261116_00 Linear is a streamlined issue tracking and project planning tool for modern teams, featuring fast workflows, keyboard shortcuts, and GitHub integrations Copy page Authentication Details Composio-managed OAuth available OAuth2 API Key Frequently Asked Questions How do I set up custom OAuth credentials for Linear? Use your own Linear OAuth application when you want users to see your app's name on the consent screen and control the credentials yourself. Create the Linear app Sign in to Linear and open your workspace's API settings . Create a new OAuth application and give it a name. In Callback URLs , enter https://backend.composio.dev/api/v1/auth-apps/add . It must exactly match the oauth_redirect_uri field in your Composio auth config. Fill in the remaining required fields and create the application. On the application page that opens, copy the Client ID and Client Secret . Create the auth config in Composio In the Composio dashboard, go to Auth Configs , click Create Auth Config , and select Linear . Set the authentication type to OAuth2 and choose Use your own developer authentication . Paste the Client ID and Client Secret , adjust the scopes if needed, then click Create Linear Auth Config . Click Connect Account , click Authorize on Linear's consent screen, and confirm the account shows as Active . See Custom auth configs for the general flow. Scopes The default auth config requests read , write , issues:create , and comments:create . Remove any you don't need from the auth config's Scopes field. Linear also offers an admin scope; add it only if your integration needs admin access. Can I connect Linear with an API key? Yes. Create an auth config with the API Key auth type. Each user creates a personal API key in Linear under Settings > Security & access > Personal API keys and pastes it when connecting. Keys start with lin_api_ .
